purpose: Repair the alignment gap between the accepted lane prototype and the intended shared-plus-generated governance architecture.

source_binding.binding_rule: Every repair output and check must identify the exact source checkpoint; a changed source closes this goal and requires a fresh source-bound successor.

phases.name: Close narrow verifier goal
phases.produces: Typed closure preserving the bounded timeout and accepted slice.
phases.check: iteration-001-closeout.v1.json binds the timeout evidence and successor reason.

phases.name: Repair Bootstrap and controller gate
phases.produces: Typed plan fields and a controller admission gate for both governance layers.
phases.check: Focused Bootstrap and Controller tests reject incomplete architecture envelopes.

phases.name: Build shared general governance library
phases.produces: Portable, deterministic, source-bound shared governance clauses and focused tests.
phases.check: General library validation and hostile portability checks pass.

phases.name: Build generated role-specific governance library
phases.produces: Deterministic role records generated from the shared library and compiled question tree.
phases.check: Role generation, digest binding, missing-tree, and missing-general-library cases pass.

phases.name: Independently check and preserve repair
phases.produces: Independent repair evidence, changed-path check, and typed Iteration handoff for anything deferred.
phases.check: All focused checks pass; no private or unrelated content is introduced.
